༄༅/ /dmag zor rgyal mo'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog dge legs nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od snang bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dmag zor rgyal mo'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog dge legs nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od snang bzhugs so// bla ma dang dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i rten rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ru mtshon bca' ba'i thabs la don gsum ste/ sbyor dngos rjes so/ /dang po ni/ rgyu'i khyad par rab chu shing / seng ldeng / stag pa la sogs pa/ de min lcang ma/ shug pa la sogs pa'i mdung shing 'dom gang las mi thung ba mtshal lam/ btsag la sogs pa dug khrag dang sbyar bas kha dog dmar po bsgyur bar bya/ gsom dben shing yin pas mi rung / glang ma 'byung po'i bla shing yin pas mi rung / thug lcags mi rta khyi gsum bsad pa'i lcags la dbyibs rtse gsum mam/ rtse mo gcig pa ral gri'i rnam pa can/ smad lcags sbubs su yod pa/ rtse mo me ris la sogs pas spras shing / rno dbal dang ldan par bya/༈ dug khrag la 'bod rbad bsad gsum gyis sngags btab pas ngar blud la/ thug rnga rab 'brong rnga g.yag 'bras bu can gyi rnga ma/ ma 'byor na rnga ma nag po gang yang rung ba rnams shing gi 'khor lo'i rgya gram la brten nas mdzes par btags/ gsung rten 'khor lo ni/ mgon po sogs nas 'byung ba'i lha mo 'dod khams ma'i 'khor lo la lte ba'i sku/ dmag zor mar bsgyur bas go chod de/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i mgon po'i chos skor khog phub snyan brgyud rin po che'i lde mig las lha mo dpon g.yog gi lo rgyus rnams gsungs pa'i mthar/ 'on kyang 'di rnams rgyud gcig pas rje mo dang g.yog mo'i rnam 'gyur g.yog ma'i rnam 'gyur gong 'dul sna tshogs su ston pa yin pas mtha' gcig tu nges pa med do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /sngags ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i bod rbad bsad gsum gyi mthar/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/

dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ sgrub pa po bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/ 'gal rkyen sol/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams la ltas dang cho 'phrul drag po mngon sum du ston la/ myur du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces pa shog bu la dug khrag gis bris pa ci mang rnams mdung shing gi rtse mo la dkris pa dar sna dang / tshon skud kyis mi 'chugs par bsdams pa lcags sbubs su bcug la gzer gyis bsdams/ sku rten ro ras sam shog bu la dmag zor rgyal mo'i sku sor bzhi pa gri khrag gis bris pa la rab gnas tshul bzhin bya/ phyag g.yas nas rim bzhin 'phred la dril/ dar skud sna lngas dkris/ dar snas bcings la gri lcags sam/ snyug rgod kyi sbubs su bcug la phyi nas la chas byugs/ srog 'khor kyang de ltar bcings la ril bya/ drag po'i shing tsher ma can la byang bu mtho gang pa bcos pa'i ngos la sngags spel tshig bcas gong bzhin bris la dug khrag dang snag tshas bris pa la chus byugs/ thugs kyi rten me long gi ngos su gri khrag dang sin+dhu ras bh+yoḥyig bris pa/ yon tan gyi rten du ras sam dar gyi khug ma'i nang du 'bru sna tshogs/ sman sna tshogs/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi bkang ba/ phrin las kyi rten du gong gi shing byang / khrab byang mig dgu pa/ bse byang / stag ras/ gzig ras 'gron bu'i len tshar dril bu/ g.yer kha/ mi mgo mi lag mi snying la sogs pa/ dar ras sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang / lan tshar ci mang / de dag thams cad gong gi rnga ma'i zhol chen gyi khrod du gdags/ de lta bu'i thug chen de dmag zor 'khor bcas kyi rten dang gtor ma legs par bshams pa'i mdun du mañdzi chen po la brten pa'am phyogs bzhir brgyang thag bya la bzhugs/ de'i mdun du stegs bu'i khar gtor ma gru gsum che ba/ gru gsum chung ba bzhi dang /

mtheb skyus bskor ba sha khrag dang dar gyis brgyan pa/ gsol kha'i chas kyi sha dum bu/ khrag chang phye mar mchod pa rnam pa lnga la sogs legs par bsham/ rnal 'byor pa dpon slob rnams kyis yi dam gyi bdag bskyed/ gtor bsngo bskang gso rnams gzhung ltar byas/ ru mtshon la dmigs te zhi drag phyed ma/ drag po rnams kyi sbyong ba khrus gsol dang bcas pa bya/ rten dang gtor ma rnams nang mchod kyis sbyangs la a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ gtor ma mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi kā pa la stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i ri bo/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phyag rgya bcas pa ci mang brjod/ ru mtshon a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ gzhal yas khang bskyed chog 'di 'jam dbyangs ral gris mdzad pa'i gtor chog las so/༈ yaṃ las rlung 'tshub rab tu 'khrug pa'i gur sngon po dang / raṃ las ye shes me rab tu 'bar ba'i nang / baṃ las khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'ang ngos bzhi bse dang zur bzhi mchong dang / rmang lcags las byas pa/ g.yu'i ba gam dang / gser gyi kha bad dang / dngul gyi sgo dang / them skas 'dzeg skas shel las byas pa/ mi ro rengs po'i ka ba dang / zhing chen gyi rgyal mtshan phyogs mtshams su btsugs pa/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re dang / rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi dang / rus pa'i drwa bas brgyan pa/ phyi rol na dur khrod brgyad mi mgo'i phreng ba dang / keng rus kyi rwa bas bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang de'i dbus su/ k+ṣa las be con k+ṣas mtshan pa las dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti dmag zor rgyal mo drel rta la zhon pa/

sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma zhal mche ba gtsigs shing / lha bskyed chog gtor bsngo sogs sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa sor bzhag go /mi ro rengs pa khar bcug pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ smin ma'i dbus su khro gnyer rab du bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa la me lce dang me stag du ma 'phro ba/ snyan g.yas pa dug sbrul g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le zhag gi zor ris/ thal chen gyi mtsho bu bkod pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang re ldes stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyi ske rags dang do shal sogs dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i tsan+dan gyi be con nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon yungs dkar dang khrag gis gang ba'i nal thod thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sga'i snga sha la nad kyi rkyal pa/ btsan gyi byang dmar/ sho rdel dkar nag 'phyang ba/ phyi sha la tshon gyi gru gu btags shing / bdud kyi khram shing sked la gzer ba/ lte ba'i thad nas nyi ma dang / spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ dbu steng du rma bya'i gdugs phub pa/ 'khor bdud phrug gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mig rtsa dmar zhing rab tu rngams pa'i cha lugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yon na yungs dkar dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs bsam pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas byang shar mtsho mu le ding gi pho brang nas dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor bcas badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ bh+yoḥ chos 'khor yongs kyi srung ma re ba ti/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing /

bstan pa bsrung dang sgrub la phan gdags phyir/ /byang shar mtshams nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /bh+yoḥrak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ rak+mo kha la raka chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye de wī ma hā kā li de wi sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ a kar+ṣa ya/ e h+ya hi ṭak+ki dza/ bh+yoḥ nag mo gdug can dregs pa can/ /kun tu khyab pa'i tshul ston ma/ /nag mo gtso mo drel rta chibs/ /'dir byon drel rta'i gdan la bzhugs/ /bh+yoḥrak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ rak+mo kha la raka chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya satwaṃ/ tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ tri sh+ya hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ bh+yoḥ za byed nag mo mche ba can/ /rgod byed ha ha nag mo khyod/ /gsod la dga' bar byed pa mo/ /bdag ni brda yi phyag bgyi'o/ /bh+yoḥrak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ rak+mo kha la raka chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo ཿhūm̐/ a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dzaḥhoḥ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chus lhag ma yar lud pa las gshin rje gshed kyis dbur brgyan/ phra mo sbom po las byung ba'i/ /bdud rtsi bran pa'i dza gad 'di/ /dmag zor lha mo la 'bul gyi/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /bh+yo ཿrak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ rak+mo kha la raka chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ chu dang ma 'dres dngas ma'i khrag /dngas ma yi ni khrag chen po/ /dmag zor rgyal mo la 'bul gyi/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ

rak+mo kha la raka chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ ma hā rak+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sha khrag bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba/ /'bru sna lnga sbyar gtor ma 'di/ /dmag zor rgyal mo la 'bul gyi/ /bstan pa srung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ rak+mo kha la raka chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī ye de wī ma hā ka li de wī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha liṃ bhuñtsa kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ a/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta aḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyong / bstan pa dang / sems can la 'tshe ba/ rnal 'byor pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod cing zhi ba/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod dbang thang rigs brgyud la sogs pa thams cad rgyas pa dang / 'gro ba ma lus pa dbang du 'dus shing legs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ bdag cag dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bu dang tsha bo rgyas pa dang / /'khor dang longs spyod rab 'phel zhing / /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /yid la brnag pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar gcod rnam mang po/ /thams cad gtan nas brlag pa dang / /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /de nas rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba dang / mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mos gtso mdzad/ dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ phyogs bcu'i gnas rnams nas byon mdun gyi nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab par bzhugs par bsam la dar nag 'phyar rol mo rnams kyi sgra sgrogs/ gu gul dang sha chen/ tshil chen/ cong zhi rnams bsres pa'i dud pa sbyar/ dam tshig gi rdo rje dar nag gi g.yab dar dang bcas pa g.yob cing mi rkang dang shugs pa'i sgras 'bod/ rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin brtan po dang ldan pas rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas te/ bh+yoḥ dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dad pa dang / /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /'dir gshegs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i srung ma spyi'i thug chog la spyan 'dren dmigs bsal 'di dang / dbu zhabs thams cad na yod pa'i dmag zor ma zhes pa'i tshig rnams kho bos bsgyur/ /e ka dza ṭi 'dod khams ma/ /dmag zor rgyal mo mthu rtsal can/ /dus bzhi'i lha mo gshegs su gsol/ /gsang ba'i yab bzhi bdud phrug tshogs/ /dkar sngo dmar ser ma mo'i 'khor/ /ba lang ma dang khri gnyan ma/ /dregs pa'i 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /sprin ltar 'thibs pas 'dir gshegs shig /glog ltar 'khyug pas 'dir gshegs shig /'brug ltar sgrogs pas 'dir gshegs shig /thog ltar 'dril pas 'dir gshegs shig /bh+yoḥ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /dam can mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas/ /byin rlabs yon tan 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bde chen rol pa'i gzhal yas khang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /bh+yoḥ sbyar ba'i spos dang g.yab pa'i dar/ /rnga chen sgra dang dung chen gling / /rnal 'byor drag po'i ngar skad kyis/ /spyan 'dren ma thog myur du byon/ /dam can rgya mtsho mthu rtsal can/

/sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba rnams/ /gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dus gyur cig /ces yid ma yengs par spyan drangs/ bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ rak+mo kha la rag chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye de wī ma hā kā li de wi sa pa ri wā ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing drag rol yun ring du bya/ re ma ti sa pā ri wā ra gṛh+na daṃ a nas shap+ta'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang / re ma ti sogs la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ mdun gyi dmag zor 'khor bcas sku la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i pho nya las mkhan nam mkha'i mtha' khyab par 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ 'khor 'das kyi nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus/ mdun bskyed rnams la thim pas gzi brjid nus pa blta bar mi bzod pa khams gsum thams cad 'dar phri li li yod par gyur/ zhes brjod/ ru mtshon la rdo rje gzungs thag dang / dar thag btags pa/ rnal 'byor pa gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin pas bzung dpon slob rnams mgrin gcig tu/ ma ma trag rak+ṣa/ dha ki dha ki trig trig dun dzaḥ ru tra ru tra/ baṃ bh+yo baṃ bh+yoḥ muṃ ni muṃ ni/ tshal pa tshal pa 'bod pa'i sngags so/ /traka rak+ṣa dgra bo ṇi mā ra ya/ tshal pa se na rbad rbad pa'i sngags so/ /ma ma trag rak+ṣa/ ṭa ki ṭa ki trig trig dgra bo'i tsit+ta la thun tsit+ta la dz+wa la raṃ/ ma ma thun rak+sha/ ma ma thun srog tsit+ta sod/ dgra bo mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sod sod/ khā hi khā hi bzhes shig rol cig ces mar pas rngog pa la gnang ba'i dud sol ma'i zhal gdams las byung ba'i bod rbad bsad gsum 'di'am/ yang na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ e h+ya hi a ra li dzaḥdzaḥ

hring hring / zhes spyan drangs so/ /ma ma trag rak+ṣa raka mu tra/ ru lu bh+yoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes las gnyer gtad do/ /nag mo kha la dza ya du dza ya du/ nag mo kha la dza ya du/ sa ma hoḥ ru lu ru lu dun bh+yoḥ snying kha la ma dun bh+yoḥ zhes rak+ta sbreng thugs dam bskang ngo / /zhes slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i ma mo srog sgrub/ 'jam dbyangs ral gris dmag zor ma'i chos skor khrod nas byung ba'i sngags 'di la bod rbad bsad gsum gyi ming btags mi 'dug kyang / don la der 'gro ste/ spyan 'dren dang bos pa don gcig gnyer gtad dang rbad pa don gcig bcol dam mam/ bskul lam/ bsad pa don gcig pas 'dir bris pa yin no/ /gang na'ang bod rbad bsad gsum de dag brgya rtsa'am/ nyer gcig tsam re 'ur 'don bya/ rnal 'byor pa gcig gam/ gnyis gsum tsam gyis gzungs thag sogs nas bzung / 'og gi bskul mi byed par/ bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ sogs lha mo 'dis sngags rgyun ma chad par bzung / gzhan rnams kyis gsol kha bya ste/ de yang sngar gyi stegs bu'i kha'i gtor ma che ba'i g.yas su sha dmar po dum bu dgu dang / chang phud gtsang ma bzhag g.yon du phye mar dang / khrag chab bzhag mdun du las kyi rdo rje zhig gis lcags snod gtsang ma'i nang du g.yas nas sha re/ g.yon nas phye mar mtheb skyu re bcug gsol kha tshar re la de 'dra ba lan gsum gtor chen la bstabs cing / g.yas g.yon nas khrag chang kyang thigs re blug rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i bye brag kun thogs nas/ mdun gyi gtor rdzas dgra bgegs kyi sha'i ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen pos stong gsum thams cad khyab par bsam la de rnams dmag zor 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal dmar gnam sa tsam gdangs pa'i nang du sib kyis btab pas hab thob tu bzhes nas/ thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas mnyes nas bdag gi ci bcol ba'i las thogs pa med par bsgrubs par bsams la/

dbyangs dang bcas/ 'di yang thug chog nas 'byung ba'i dgongs gsol la dmag zor kho nar kho bos bsgyur/༈ bh+yoḥ lha mo'i mtshan gsol dpal ldan re ma ti/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba/ /gdug pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal can/ /bdud 'dul dpa' mo dmag zor 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag cag rnams la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /'dod yon rgya chen gtor ma'i rgya mtsho dang / /longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor bcas la/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa dam par 'bul/ /dgyes pa'i sems kyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi thugs dam 'phrin las nyer dgongs la/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /'dod don mthun pa'i rkyen rnams sgrub pa dang / /thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas 'dur dbyangs bya zhing / bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo/ /sa bcu dbang phyug chen mo/ /rgyal ba'i bka' srung dam pa/ lha srung yongs kyi ded dpon/ /dur khrod kun gyi bdag po/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing / /rnam 'byor kun gyi dgra lha/ /bstan pa yongs kyi bya ra ba/ /dug gsum nad gyi sman pa/ /bdud 'dul rnams kyi dpa' mo/ /me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las 'khol mo'i mtshan gyis rnam grangs sbas pa'i bu mo nas nag mo re ma ti zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa btus pa'o/༈ sbas pa'i bu mo thal mdog mi pham khro gnyer ro longs ma/ re ma ti/ dmar 'dab phur pa'i lha ser can/ chu srin mgo bo can/ klu mo re ma ti/ srid pa gsum gyi blo 'phrog ma/ ya mtshan 'phrul gyi gshog pa can/ yak+ṣa re ma ti/ rdo rje glog ma sprin/ gnod sbyin bshan pa nag mo re ma ti/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma/ gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams kyi bdud mo khyed kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/

zhes brjod cing gong du bshad pa'i gtor sngags lan gsum rol chen dang bcas pas gsol dang po bstab/ yang sngar bzhin bshams la/ gzhan yang thabs mchog yab bzhi po 'di yang me lce 'bar min rgyud la sogs/ 'byung po dge ba/ bgegs rgyal bi na ya ka gnod sbyin yak+ṣa kā la/ dri bzhon wa ya wo/ bdud phrug bye ba 'bum sde/ dkar mo zhal gyis bzhes ma/ sngon mo ral pa 'dzings ma/ dmar mo gtum mo chen mo/ ser mo mkha' la bzhed ma/ ba lang dred sna ma/ khri gnyen sa le ma/ 'khor gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ bdud rgyal gyi dmag dpung nyi khri chig stong / lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong / dur khrod kyi bdag mo/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad/ mdun gyi shul 'dren/ g.yas g.yon gyi ru 'dren/ rgyab kyi rjes myul/ mkha' lding bya nag de mo/ nag mo/ khyi nag ce spyang sngon po/ mi nag po 'o dod can/ sprul pa'i khro bo'i tshogs/ bdud nag po gshin rje'i tshogs/ gdong can gyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchod pa dam par 'bul zhing gsol lo mchod do/ /rol chen/ a kā ro lan gsum bzlas shing gsol kha gnyis pa bstabs/ yang bshams la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang bstan pa rin po che la dgongs te khyed rnams kyis dges shing mos pa'i thabs kyis bzhes la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad gyi nad dang gnod pa/ gdon bgegs thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par spel/ dbang phyug dang nus mthu bskyed/ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrubs/ dregs pa'i 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du bsdus/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog cig gzhan yang bdag cag rnams kyi rgyags chad kyi ma mdzod dang / blo lhag pa'i pha mdzod cig rgyab kyi slog pa dang /

mdun gyi 'khar ba mdzod/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra dang / mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slongs/ chad na 'thud cig ral na tshems shig stor na 'tshol la/ brjed na bskul cig mgo gang gi yar la bstod la/ dkyus gang gi mar la srings shig gzhan yang legs pa brgya dang sprod la/ nyes pa stong dang bsnol cig bsam pa yid bzhin sgrubs la/ re ba rgya mtsho lta bur skongs shig mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cig gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan la brtan par bzhugs te dgra dpung choms la bgegs dpung thams cad shigs cig dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang chen po bstod cig gzhan yang spo la dar 'phyor la/ khrom du dung bus shig gtam ngan rgyun chod la/ snyan grags 'jig rten du sgrogs shig dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la phyor la/ mtho ris dang thar pa byang chub bsgrub pa'i mgon grogs mdzod cig skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dang / rten dang / brling mdzod cig bdag cag gis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad myur du sgrub shig gong du bshad pa'i gtor sngags dang / a kā ro rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha gsum pa bstabs/ slar yang de 'dra tshar gnyis te yongs dril tshar gsum rdzogs pa dang / de dag gi lhag ma lus pa rnams kyang bstabs/ de nas mnga' gsol dpangs bstod rgyas par bya ba ni/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ mnga' gsol 'di la bdag chen grags blo ba'i gsung phran bu ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma kho bo rang gi gsar rtsom/༈ bh+yoḥ chos dbyings shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma gcig dmag zor rgyal mo la/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas mnga' gsol bas/ /byin brlabs sprin phung thibs se thib/ /yi dam rgya mtshos mnga' gsol bas/ /grub gnyis zim char thu lu lu/

sangs rgyas rnams kyis mnga'༞ /ye shes rgya mtsho khyi li li/ /dam pa'i chos kyis mnga'༞ /yid bzhin nor bu me re re/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun mnga'༞ /'phrin las gzi 'od gsal la la/ /dam can rgya mtshos mnga'༞ /drag shul snang ba 'tshe re re/ /nor lha rnams kyis mnga'༞ /phywa g.yang bang mdzod khrigs se khrig /gter bdag rnams kyis mnga'༞ /phun tshogs 'dod dgu nyi li li/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis mnga'༞ /gang sku in+d+ra ni li'i mdog /bstan srung drag mor mnga'༞ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis kun la 'khyud/ /bcom ldan rigs lngas mnga'༞ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /ging chen dpa' bos mnga'༞ /rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo/ /sgeg mo dpa' mos mnga'༞ /rin chen rgyan cha si li li/ /bdud dpung 'joms par mnga'༞ /tsan+dan be con klad la bskor/ /dngos grub stsol bar mnga'༞ /nal thod khrag gang phyag na bsnams/ /tshangs pa nas rnam sras mnga' gsol gyis bar me lce 'bar ba nas bshad pa'i lo rgyus dang sbyar/ tshangs pa'i rgyal pos mnga'༞ /rma bya'i sgro gdugs gtsug na lding / /nye ba'i dbang pos mnga'༞ /nyi zla gtsug dang lte ba brgyan/ /klu rgyal dga' bos mnga'༞ /'jigs pa'i brang 'gros snyan g.yas mdzes/ /lha phran rnams kyis mnga'༞ /de la gser gyi dril bu gsil/ /rnam thos sras kyi mnga'༞ /snyan g.yon seng ge'i rgyan gyis spras/ /snyan grags kun gyis mnga'༞ /de yi nga ros stong gsum g.yo/ /'od lha dkar pos mnga'༞ /sna tshogs dar gyi cod paṇa bklubs/ /sha za mkha' 'gro mnga'༞ /sku stod zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /'jigs rung srin mor mnga'༞ /re lde'i gos kyis rnam par brgyan/ /snang srid ma mos mnga'༞ /dam nyams mgo rlon 'phreng ba 'phyang / /dregs pa yongs kyis mnga'༞ /stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ /dur khrod bdag pos mnga'༞ /khrag zhag thal ba'i thig le can/ /dung skyong khol mo mnga'༞ /srin po'i dre'u gwa dmar chibs/

/rak+ṣa rā dzas mnga'༞ /zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog dag gis mdzes/ /bstan 'dzin yongs kyis mnga'༞ /bzhon pa zangs sga sogs kyis brgyan/ /ri nag dpung pas mnga' gsol bas/ /bdud kyi khram shing rked la gzer/ /yam shud dmar pos mnga'༞ /btsan gyi byang dmar mchan du bcug /rims bdag kun gyis mnga'༞ /snga shar nad kyi rkyal pa bkal/ /rdo rje zla bas mnga'༞ /sho rde dkar nag 'phyang 'phrul can/ /mtsho sman rgyal mos mnga'༞ /phyi shar mtshon gyi gru gu btags/ /stong gsum 'dul bar mnga'༞ /rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i dbus na bzhugs/ /bgegs dpung sreg par mnga'༞ /bskal pa'i me dpung phyogs bcur g.yo/ /zhing bcu'i gshed mar mnga'༞ /sha khrag rus pa srog dbugs rol/ /dmag zor rgyal mor mnga'༞ /srid gsum dregs pa dbang du bsdus/ /dur khrod bdag mor mnga'༞ /'jigs rung 'khor gyis kun nas bskor/ /bh+yoḥ ma gcig gnyen gyi re ma ti/ /dbang phyug chen po srid pa'i yab/ /na la rtse ni khro mo'i yum/ /rje gcig lha mo dung skyong ma/ /khol mo dmar 'dab phur pa'i lha/ /gsang ba'i yab bzhi bde ba'i mdzod/ /sras ni bdud phrug bye ba 'bum/ /sprul pa dus bzhi'i lha mo dang / /re ma ti bzhi tshe ring lnga/༈ phur srung bdag nyid ma/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma/༈ /nam gru mched brgyad bcu gnyis sde/ /yang sprul pho nyar bcas pa rnams/ /gzi brjid chen po mnga' gsol lo/ /mthu rtsal chen por dbang bskur ro/ /drag shul chen por dpangs bstod do/ /thugs rje ldan par gsol 'debs so/ /phrin las mdzad par bdag bskul lo/ /dgra bo sgrol bar dus 'debs so/ /mgrin bzang gwa dmar dre'u dmar/ /g.yag lug khyi spyang bya mo nag /phyi rten rdzas mchog mchod pa yis/ /phyi yi srung mar mnga' gsol lo/ /dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang / /sha khrag mchod gtor rten mdos sogs/ /nang gi rten rdzas sna tshogs kyis/ /nang gi srung mar mnga' gsol lo/

/nal bu'i sha khrag rgyal mtshan dang / /shing lo ma lhung dpa' bo'i sha /gsang ba'i rten rdzas sna tshogs kyis/ /gsang ba'i srung mar mnga' gsol lo/ /bh+yoḥ gsang ba chen po gnas mchog 'dir/ /sha khrag gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ /dza gad bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /dri bsur ngad pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /'dod dgu sna tshogs char ltar 'bab/ /ting 'dzin sngags kyis byin rlabs nas/ /sngar bcol gtang rag 'di 'bul lo/ /da bcol zhu skyems 'di 'dren no/ /bzhes shig rol cig dgongs par mdzod/ /mchod ni dam rdzas gtor mas mchod/ /gsol ni spyan gzigs mchod pas gsol/ /rten ni ru mtshon rtags la brtan/ /'bod ni dung chen gling bus 'bod/ /bskang ni mthun pa'i rdzas kyi bskang / /rbad do sdang byed dgra la rbad/ /bskul lo drag po'i las la bskul/ /chos so dpa' bo dmag la chos/ /bsten no dmag zor rgyang ma ring / /bskul lo dmag zor phrag ma dog /g.yab bo dmag zor spyan ma rtul/ /'bod do dmag zor snyan ma sra/ /gsol lo dmag zor thugs ma ring / /gtad do dmag zor mthu ma chung / /bskul lo dmag zor rtsal ma zhan/ /dam can bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dam bcas zhal bzhes mdzad pa rnams/ /mthu dang ldan par mnga' gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bu bzhin skyongs/ /rtsal dang ldan par mnga'༞ /bstan 'dzin skyes pu'i dbu 'phang bstod/ /sha la sred par mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra po'i sha la hab se hab/ /khrag la rngams par mnga'༞ /dgra bo'i khrag la hub se hub/ /srog la dbang bar mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra srog da lta chod la shog /dmag dpon chen por mnga'༞ /sde brgyad dmag dpung dgra la drongs/ /bstan srung chen por mnga'༞ /bstan la gnod byed rdul du rlog /chos skyong chen por mnga'༞ /chos 'khor dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /rig 'dzin srung mar mnga'༞ /gsang sngags mthu dang nus pa bskyed/ /rnal 'byor dgra lhar mnga'༞ /bcol ba'i las rnams myur du sgrubs/

/zhi ba'i las la mnga'༞ /nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /rgyas pa'i las la mnga'༞ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par spel/ /dbang gi las la mnga'༞ /khams gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /drag po'i las la mnga'༞ /bstan la gnod cing sdang ba dang / /bla mar brnyas shing sems can 'tshe/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa yi/ /dgra bo dam nyams las ngan 'di/ /da lta bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /drag po'i mtshon cha char ltar phob/ /'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /sha khrag rus pa tshogs su rol/ /don snying sna lnga zhal du gsol/ /yan lag mgo chod rgyan du gyis/ /skyob pa'i lha dang myur du phyes/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' ma bcag /bla ma brgyud pa'i dam ma g.yel/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi ngag ma bcag /dus la bab bo srung ma'i tshogs/ /khams gsum dgra bo'i srog dbugs la/ /dbang zhing rngams par mnga'༞ /zhes brjod/ de nas gzungs thag rnams bkrol/ khrag chang 'thor ba la brtson pas/ mdun gyi srung ma rnams la pho nya las mkhan stong gsum khyab par 'phros nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs med du bsgrub cing / khyad par dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ sha khrag rus pa sogs rjes med du bzhes/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drangs par bsam la/ 'jam dbyangs ral gris mdzad/༈ bh+yoḥnyi ma byang shar phyogs mtshams nas/ /'khor 'das gnyis kyi mtshams shed na/ /brag dang chu 'thab mtshams shed na/ /khrag gi rgya mtsho mu le dengs/ /khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang shed na/ /mthing gur sngon po ldi ri ri/ /bse yi sku mkhar ldem se ldem/ /mchong zur smug po gsal la la/ /g.yu pad sngon po thibs se thib/ /gser gyi ba gam 'tshe re re/ /gnyan te de la char mi 'bab/ /mtho ste de la rgod mi lding / /mtha' ni lcags ri nag pos bskor/ /gnyen te de la bdud mi 'da'/ /lcags kyi 'gram gzhi khrigs se khrig /gnyan te de la byi mi 'dzul/

/shel gyi sgo bzhi thams se tham/ /byu ru'i skas pa dmar la 'tsher/ /mi lpags rlon pa'i bla re dang / /ro skra'i rnga g.yab nyi li li/ /rkang dung gling bu kyu ru ru/ /thod pa'i rnga chung khro lo lo/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus/ /ya mtshan lha mo re ma ti/ /sku mdog sngo nag ral pa can/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi ma gcig ma/ /dam can kun gyi srung ma'i gtso/ /dam nyams kun gyi bshan pa mo/ /zhal nas mi khrag rta khrag 'dzag /spyan nas khrag 'dzag zu lu lu/ /sku stod mi lpags re ldes brgyan/ /sku smad stag gi sham thabs can/ /g.yas kyis be con mkha' la 'phyar/ /dgra bgegs ma lus rdul du rlog /g.yon na thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin/ /dgra bo'i yul du khrag zor 'phen/ /chibs su dril rta rngams pa chibs/ /chibs kyi rna ba g.yas pa la/ /le brgan dmar po pu ru ru/ /chibs kyi rna ba g.yon pa la/ /mthing nag cod paṇa pu ru ru/ /chibs kyi dpral ba'i dbyings shed na/ /me long rgya long ta la la/ /chibs kyi mgul pa dang po na/ /gser gyi dril bu si li li/ /zhing lpags rlon pa'i gdan steng na/ /gser sga dmar po wangs se wang / /mchong gi glo gnan khyugs se khyug /sbrul gyi gong rmed sha ra ra/ /g.yu mthur sngon po sgrengs se sgreng / /gser gyi srab mda' si li li/ /thod pa'i pho long khra la la/ /rin chen gser kha si li li/ /chibs kyi rnga long g.yas pa la/ /nad kyi rkyal pa sngo dmar bkal/ /dgra yi yul du rims nad thong / /chibs kyi phyi sha g.yas pa la/ /tshon gyi gru gu sngo dmar bkal/ /dgra bgegs tshon gyi thag pas chings/ /khur ni bdud kyi khram baṃ khur/ /sang phod deng sang su 'chi ba/ /de kun bdud kyi khram la 'debs/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs khram la thob/ /mdun na btsan gyi sho rdel 'grems/ /sang phod deng sang su 'chi ba/ /de kun sho rdel nag po 'grems/

/dgra bgegs sho rde'i rtsis su chug /khyod kyi mchan khung g.yas pa na/ /byang dmar dkyus kyi baṃ so 'bring / /sang phod deng sang su 'chi ba/ /de kun byang dmar dkyus la 'brid/ /dgra bgegs byang dmar dkyus su chug /ma mo 'khor bcas dgra la bh+yoḥ rims nad thams cad dgra la thongs/ /nad rims thams cad dgra la thongs/ /glo bur ye 'drog dgra la thongs/ /dus 'khrug dgra bo'i yul du thongs/ /dam nyams dgra la smyo 'bog thongs/ /dgra brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /dgra bo'i bla tshe khug la shog /dgra bo'i yul kun stong par gyis/ /dgra sha zo la dgra khrag 'thung / /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bcol ba'i las 'di 'grub par gyis/ /dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung / /bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhan/ /bdag gi 'khor dang longs spyod dang / /dbang phyug ye shes rgyas par mdzod/ /phas kyi rbod gtong bzlog pa dang / /nad kha rims kha dgra la sgyur/ /rkyen ngan mtshon kha dgra la sgyur/ /mi kha god kha dgra la sgyur/ /bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ /khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che/ /phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du/ /dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /'chi med 'khon rigs sa skya pa'i/ /gdung brgyud chad med chu rgyun bzhin/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs myur byon nas/ /bzhed don mthar phyin mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /lugs gnyis chab srid dbyar mtsho ltar/ /'phel zhing rgyas nas srid mtha'i bar/ /mi nyams brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /drag po'i 'phrin las 'dus pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo yis/ /gang bcol 'phrin las myur du mdzod/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /ri rab rtse ltar mtho bar mdzod/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /nyi zla'i 'od ltar gsal bar mdzod/ /chu bo'i rgyun ltar ring bar mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang /

/skye 'gro dar zhing bstan pa rgyas/ /yams nad mu ge mi 'byung zhing / /bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /de nas dmag zor 'khor bcas 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gzi brjid nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ 'phyar ba dang phyogs su gdengs pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i ru mtshon de nyid dmag zor 'khor bcas la brten du 'bul ba ni/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /lha srin dregs pa'i 'khor bcas dgongs/ /u ma nas 'khor bcas rnams kyis bar kho bos brtsams/༈ u ma de wa dung skyong ma/ /dmag zor lha mo sprul par bcas/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag la brtser dgongs rten la bzhugs/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i ro thang 'dir/ /khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i rba klong ljongs/ /dam nyams dam can bsgyel ba'i khrir/ /brten par btsugs pa'i ru mtshon mdung / /dpag bsam ljon pa'i srog shing rtser/ /rno dbal gri lcags mdung so la/ /dug khrag sngags rgod ngar dang ldan/ /lhab lhab 'bar ba'i me 'od can/ /g.yag rgod rog po'i rnga g.yab kyi/ /zhol chen sprin nag lta bur gtibs/ /dar nag ba dan 'phan rtse gsum/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i phur lding g.yo/ /sku rten ro ras tsa ka li/ /gsung rten srog 'khor gsang ba'i sngags/ /thugs rten gsal ba'i me long dang / /yon tan rten du nyer lnga'i rdzas/ /'phrin las rten du dar ras 'phan/ /bse lcags shing byang dam nyams kyi/ /mgo la 'gron bu'i lan tshar can/ /dril bu g.yer kha sil sil 'khrol/ /phun tshogs rgyu las legs grub cing / /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin rlabs pa'i/ /thug chen 'bar ba drag po'i rten/ /rten mchog ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /bzhugs pa'i pho brang chen por 'dzugs/

/byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin sngon las/ /dngos grub char rgyun dus 'dir phob/ /dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'du ba'i gnas dang rten du 'dzugs/ /pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar/ /'bral med 'dus nas las kun sgrubs/ /dregs byed dmag dpung ru mtshon mchog /g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bstan dang rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /sdang byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod kyi/ /srog shing tshe yi rten du 'dzugs/ /mi nor chos dang legs tshogs kun/ /rab tu rgyas shing brtan par mdzod/ /de ltar ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /da bcol zhu ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bsam don 'grub pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /snang srid dregs byed gzhi bdag rnams/ /ru mtshon 'di la brtan bzhugs nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bstan pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ /nyin mtshan bya ra mel tshe dang / /byang chub bar gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /ces brjod pas mdun gyi bla ma yi dam srung ma rnams dang / snang srid dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad mtsho la char babs pa bzhin du ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan de nyid la thim par bsam zhing / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug khyed rnams rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor dgon gnas longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod cig bstan pa dang rnam 'byor la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig nyid la tshar chod/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi srog la dbang mdzod cig ces lan gsum brjod cing / me tog gtor shis brjod kyi tshig skabs su gang babs brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/

gtor sgrub kyi lhan thabs las 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /de ltar dmag zor rgyal mo'i ru mtshon gyi rten de nyid gang du yod par dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams mkha' la sprin 'du ba'am mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba'am/ sha rul la sbrang ma 'du ba ltar gnas de nyid du brtan par bzhugs nas yul phyogs dge mtshan ldan pa/ sgrub pa po rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don thams cad bsgrubs par 'gyur bas tshul 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo la brten pa'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog dge legs nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od snang zhes bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dpal ldan sa skya'i dam can srung ma rnams kyi ru mtshon 'dzugs chog la gzhi byas lha mo 'di rang gi khyad chos rnams 'jam dbyangs ral gris mdzad pa'i dmag zor ma'i sgrub skor dang / gsang sngags chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i bskang gso/ tshar chen rin po ches bsgrigs gnang gi du pod chung rnams nas kha bskangs/ rang gi rnam dpyod phra mo'i sgor shar ba rnams 'gal med du sbyar nas bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis so// ༈ /dmag zor rgyal mo'i thug chog gi zin bris bzhugs so// ༈ /swasti/ dmag zor thug chog la nyer mkho'i zin bris ni/ rgyas 'bring gnyis la gtor bsngo bskang ba sogs rgyun gyi thugs dam dang sbrel dgos kyang / 'dir ru mtshon 'dzugs chog rkyang pa'i dbang du byas na/ bdag bskyed bla med mchog sgrub lha gang rung dang / /khyad par shis pa gshin rje dang phur pa yin pas/ 'dir phur pa bya ba'i dbang du btang nas/ de yang mngon rtogs bsdus pa stabs bde bas/ bsham gyi skabs phur gtor gcig sman rag gnyis yod med gang rung gis go chod/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzlas pa bsdu ba'i rgyun bzhin/ bum pa badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs bskyed chog spyi 'gre la/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ ljang sngon yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang rgya gram/ g.yon dang po gnyis kyis thod khrag dang be con/ mtha' ma gnyis kyis ri rab kyi phur bu sgril zhing / rdo rje'i khyung gshog can gyi pang na yum rdo rje sgra mdzad ma ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas dril bu/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang dpal gyi chas dang / khro bo khro mo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas ye shes kyi lha oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun ḍa li badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya nas/ ko3 haṃ gi bar/ thabs kyi spyod pas nas/ āḥzhes pa'i bar/ yab yum gnyis la khro bo rigs lnga re res dbu brgyan/ sgeg phreng sogs/ rang byung sogs/ 'khor ba'i nyon mongs dug dang 'dra ba la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i sman gyi rtsi gtor nas/ /thugs rje kun la khyab pa'i dbyings su 'khyil/ /khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sogs/ rang gi snying kha nas sogs/ las sngags brgya rtsa bzlas pa'i mthar/ mchod bstod gong bzhin yig brgya gsum/ ma 'byor ba sogs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis mchod yon phul/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yab yum 'od du zhu bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gyur/ sbyang ba dang bgegs bskrad rgyun bzhin la/ tshig bsgyur ni deng 'dir dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i nang rten du ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i sogs/

gzhan 'gre/ bden bdar ni/ e raṃ nas dza'i bar brub khung bskyed chog dang bskul med pas bzhag na mo nas byin gyis brlabs kyi bar phur pa'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ deng 'dir sogs gang gi rigs 'gre sbyar bsam shes/ khrus rgyun gyi gzhi bdag khrus gsol bzhin la sku phyi rjes ma'i mthar bkra shis mi dgos/ khyad par spyan 'dren gyi 'gor bcom dung dang / bcom rol pa rang bzhin la spyan 'dren sh+lau ka gnyis la de wī ko ṭa'i dbyangs 'khor gnyis rol mo bcas tshig rkang dgu ma dang bdun ma'i khyad bsgyur/ de phyin 'dur ma/ bh+yoḥ gnyis kyi 'go dang / dam tshig dbang gis 'dus gyur rnams la tshig rol mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rjes ma'i mthar chems brdung gsum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ phyi nang gi mchod pa la so so'i phyag rgya/ bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags tshan drug so so nas nyer gcig re yan bcad la bzla/ rang gcig pu yin na/ gzungs thag bsdu/ gzhan yod na sngags rgyun 'dzin/ gsol kha'i dbyangs rol sogs lag len rnams kho bos sbyar ba'i mgon mdos phyag deb bzhin/ gsum pa rdzogs pa'i mthar rol mo gsum brdeg 'phar mar bsgyur/ mnga' gsol tshig rkang lnga la gzhan yang ma ring mo'i dbyangs rol/ de yang lha mo la dbyangs 'di dgos pa khyad par can yod de/ lo chen rin chen bzang po dang / lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi gtam rgyud bzhin no/ /de phyin rnga nang brdung 'phar ma/ bh+yoḥ gnyis kyi 'gor tshig rol mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rjes mar dgu brdung gcig drag bskul la rnga phyir brdung 'phar ma/ zhi bar mdzod la tshig rol dgu brdung gi mthar gsum brdeg len can/ de phyin rnga nang brdung 'phar ma'i mthar tshig rol chems brdung sgang dung / gsum brdeg len can/ 'bul tshig gi 'gor bcom dung bcom rol gsum brdeg len can lugs 'bul tshig bsangs mgo bzhin/

sh+lau ka gnyis la dus gsum bde bar gshegs ma'i dbyangs 'khor gnyis rol mo bcas/ u ma'i 'gor yang bh+yoḥsbyar/ de phyin rnga nang nas brdung 'phar ma'i mthar tshig rol chems brdung gi mjug gur drag mchod rol bzhin/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug sogs la rab gnas kyi brtan bzhugs bzhin las drag rol drag dung / gsum pa rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can/ bkra shis dril gsil ma ci rigs kyi mthar rol mo bya zhing / phur pa'i tshogs bsdus pa/ bshags pa'i mthar gsum brdeg len can/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs mjug chog rgyun bzhin la/ brtan bzhugs las gshegs gsol mi dgos so/ /rgyas pa ni 'di'i steng du yang gong ma'i yig cha mang po nas kha bskang dgos shing / 'bring po'i rgyas pa ni 'di la srung ma spyi sgos kyi gtor bsngo dang / bskang ba sbyar/ gdan sa 'dir yang rang gi phyag len ltar na rdor glu rdzogs rjes ru mtshon 'dzugs chog btang / tshogs kyi mthar/ spyi bstabs dang mjug chog rgyun bskang bzhin/ 'bring po dngos ni gong 'khod sor bzhag bsdus pa ni srung ma gang yin de'i bskang ba'i mjug tu ru mtshon 'bul tshig kho na brjod pa yin no/ /zhes pa'ang kun blos smras so// //dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 kun dga' blo gros/ dmag zor rgyal mo'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 19
